activity_statements.statement: designs and develops athletic footwear, apparel, and equipment for a wide variety of sports and fitness activities under the Nike, Jordan, and Converse brands
markets and sells products through Nike Direct (owned retail stores and digital platforms) and wholesale accounts including sporting goods retailers and department stores in nearly every country
outsources nearly all footwear and apparel manufacturing to independent contract factories primarily outside the US, managing 184 strategic Tier 2 material suppliers as of May 2025
operates digital commerce platforms in 40+ countries and 72 distribution centers outside the US to fulfill direct-to-consumer orders
runs innovation research to design performance footwear and apparel that reduces injury, maximizes athletic comfort, and decreases environmental impact
markets apparel with licensed college and professional team and league logos through wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels
operates Converse as a separate segment, designing, marketing, licensing, and selling casual sneakers, apparel, and accessories globally
generated FY2025 total revenue of approximately $44B, with footwear at $29.5B, apparel $13B, and Nike Direct contributing $18.8B

segments.name: Nike Brand — International (EMEA, Greater China, APLA)

name_reality_gap: Index label 'Retail' understates the reality: Nike is primarily a design and brand-management company that outsources nearly all manufacturing; its largest operational investments are in product design/innovation, digital platforms, and global brand marketing — not store operations or physical retail infrastructure.
extraction_notes: nike.com returned 404/500 errors; profile built from SEC 10-K (FY2025), Nike careers page, and earnings release. Very high confidence due to detailed 10-K content.
